name: draft-run-stream
title: Draft model call streams via agent.run_stream to avoid gateway non-streaming timeout
description: Draft still fails (llm_provider_error) behind knowledge-base-gateway, which enforces a hardcoded 60s RequestTimeout on non-streaming requests (internal/config/config.go:94, not env-tunable). Switch service/operation.py draft model call from agent.run to agent.run_stream so the structured output is streamed and aggregated, avoiding the gateway's whole-request non-streaming deadline. Keep persistence timing and SSE event contract unchanged.
creator: lenny
